results.content: # Bank of Canada to raise rates to 2.50% on October 28 and once again by end-March: Reuters poll. BENGALURU, Oct 23 (Reuters) - The Bank of Canada will raise its overnight rate by 25 basis points to 2.50% on October 28 and follow with one more hike by the end of March to pre-empt any further rise in inflation expectations, according to a ​majority of economists polled by Reuters. Nineteen of 34 economists surveyed in the October 21-23 poll, or 56% of them, said the BoC will hike its overnight rate by a quarter percentage point to 2.50%, its ​first move in a year.
